item.description: Oil prices rose Monday as investors assessed fresh obstacles to U.S.-Iran diplomacy and persistent security risks around Middle Eastern energy supplies.

item.description: The reporter sits down with WSJ Editor in Chief Emma Tucker to discuss his arrest and imprisonment in Moscow’s infamous Lefortovo prison.

item.description: Plus: AI a nightmare for regulators and U.S. defense firms push to build missile output is coming too late.

item.title: A Supermarket Opened a Pub to Get Around Liquor Laws. Now It Needs Bouncers.

item.title: Looking at Europe’s Glass as Half-Full
